articles.title: See photos of last night’s ‘blood moon’ lunar eclipse - The Boston Globe
articles.description: The cosmic spectacle was visible in parts of New England as well as South America, Europe, western Asia, Africa, and Antarctica.
articles.content: The air molecules from the atmosphere scatter out most of the blue light. The remaining light reflects onto the moons surface with a red glow, making the moon appear a crimson or ruddy brown color in… [+887 chars]
